title: FleetDM Overview
description: Hosts of a Fleet server (status, platforms, OS versions, disk, failing policies, vulnerabilities, MDM), its global policies and its activity feed.

definition.content:
**Fleet** (FleetDM) manages and queries laptops, desktops and servers with osquery, and their MDM. This dashboard shows the hosts of the connected Fleet server (online or not, last seen, platforms and OS versions, disk space, failing policies, vulnerabilities, MDM enrollment and disk encryption), its global policies and its activity feed: logins, policies and queries changed, live queries, scripts run, software installed, hosts locked or wiped.

Connect a Fleet server in [Integrations → FleetDM](/integrations/fleetdm): ObserveCraft reads its API every minute, for self-hosted Fleet and Fleet's cloud alike.

definition.title: Scripts, software and MDM actions on hosts
definition.query: source:fleetdm @evt.name:(ran_script OR installed_software OR uninstalled_software OR locked_host OR unlocked_host OR wiped_host OR read_host_disk_encryption_key OR mdm_enrolled OR mdm_unenrolled OR transferred_hosts)

definition.title: Policies, queries and configuration changed
definition.query: source:fleetdm @evt.name:(created_policy OR edited_policy OR deleted_policy OR applied_spec_policy OR created_saved_query OR edited_saved_query OR deleted_saved_query OR applied_spec_saved_query OR live_query OR edited_agent_options OR added_script OR deleted_script OR added_software OR deleted_software)
